semiconductor_relevance: Medium — ARKTECH provides precision sheet metal processing and manufacturing equipment that supports semiconductor manufacturing operations.
summary: ARKTECH specializes in precision sheet metal processing and manufacturing equipment, offering products such as medical carts, transport equipment, and washing baskets for the semiconductor industry. Their advanced technologies, including fiber laser welding and laminated sheet metal processing, enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
capabilities: Fiber laser welding of dissimilar materials

regional_presence.Japan: ARKTECH is recognized for its commitment to quality in Japan, being the first in the precision sheet metal industry to obtain ISO 9001 certification.
